title: Soda farls with green beans and white bean mash

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, bicarb, vinegar, tinned cannellini beans, olive oil and fresh vegetables are all ordinary home staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at Tesco or similar.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a frying pan and a masher, and soda farls are within a confident beginner's reach.

works.reason: The flour, bicarb and liquid are in sensible soda farl proportions, 8 minutes a side on low heat will cook the quarters through, and a tin of beans and 300g green beans comfortably top four farls.

honest_times.reason: Mixing the dough, trimming 300g beans, halving tomatoes, mashing and frying fit about 25 active minutes, and the 16 minutes of farl cooking matches the 20 cook minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and only water is added.

seasonal_feel.reason: September green beans and cherry tomatoes make up the warm topping, and the beans are a main part of the dish rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a neighbour could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal farls with a bean mash and vegetables make a filling snack of real food.
